To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the eikonal model is strongly preferable for the phenomenological analysis of elastic high energy hadron collisions and, in particular, that elastic proton-proton collisions are more peripheral than inelastic collisions.

the eikonal model is a strongly preferable tool for the analysis of high energy elastic hadron-hadron collisions and that the impact parameter profiles, derived in the framework of this model, are able to describe experimental data.
the elastic high energy nucleon-nucleon collisions are peripheral and the corresponding eikonal profile is very similar to the one for the inelastic collisions.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following problems: (i) to develop the eikonal model for the description of the nucleon-nucleon elastic scattering at high energies; (ii) to study the impact-parameter dependence of the nucleon elastic scattering at the LHC energies and to estimate the range of the nuclear forces; (iii) to analyze the experimental data on elastic nucleon collisions in the framework of the eikonal approach.

the elastic hadron-nucleon collisions at high energies are predominantly peripheral.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the eikonal model is the most preferable approach for the description of high energy elastic collisions, but the experimental information on the impact parameter profiles remains insufficient.
the eikonal model of elastic high energy hadron collisions can be applied successfully for the analysis of experimental data.
the impact parameter profiles are more peripheral than the ones obtained from phenomenological fits to experimental data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the eikonal model is the only approach that can be used for the analysis of hadron collisions.
the elastic hadron-hadron collisions can be treated as the peripheral ones, and this conclusion can be derived in the framework of the eikonal model.
the eikonal model is a very good approximation to describe elastic hadron collisions.
